text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Each mark is one of the 35 labelled events lasting over 1 day. Dashed lines: the 4.0 noise-unit alarm threshold of the benchmark detector and the 25% share used for the injected transfers. Noise unit: the usual size of the 24-hour step on odd-numbered months.'

alarm threshold of the benchmark detector and the 25% share used for the injected transfers.
Noise unit: the usual size of the 24-hour step on odd-numbered months.
